title: Programme Office Memorandum on the Basis of the Tier Review under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme
content:
# Programme Office Memorandum — Basis of the Tier Review under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme

## 1. The basis

The tier under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme is reviewed at the interval the programme sets, and the review is decided on the qualifying spend recorded since the current tier took effect. The interval, each tier's entry spend, its maintenance spend, its grace months and whether an upgrade into it takes effect at once are each fixed by tier.

The qualifying spend the review is decided on is the total, over the membership year running from the date the current tier took effect to the day of handling, of the qualifying spend on the earning entries booked to the membership less the spend given back on the reversal entries booked to it in that year. A member meets their tier when that total is not less than the tier's maintenance spend.

## 2. Moving up

A member who reaches a higher tier's entry spend moves up, at once at the tiers that upgrade immediately and at the next review at the tiers that do not.

## 3. Moving down

A member who falls below their tier's maintenance spend keeps the tier for the grace months the tier allows and then moves down one tier, never more than one tier at a review.

## 4. Reset of qualifying spend

Qualifying spend is reset to zero when the new tier takes effect, so spend is never counted toward two membership years.

## 5. The tier held

The tier a member holds is the tier recorded on the membership at the moment of handling, and a promise of a coming upgrade does not confer the tier's benefits early.

## 6. What the records show

When a membership year closes, the membership moves from active to review pending, and the spend the review will be decided on is recorded on it. When the review is settled, the membership returns to active, the tier for the coming year is recorded together with the date it took effect and the date of the next review, and the qualifying spend recorded is reset to zero for the new membership year. A lapsed membership on which the member has spent enough to bring it back to life returns to active, with the date the tier took effect again and the date of the next review.

## 7. Worked review (hypothetical figures)

Assume a tier whose maintenance spend is USD 5000.00, and a membership year since the current tier took effect in which the following are booked:

| Entry | Qualifying spend |
|---|---|
| earning entry, merchandise | USD 3000.00 |
| earning entry, custom commission | USD 2800.00 |
| reversal entry, return of merchandise | USD 600.00 given back |

The total is USD 3000.00 plus USD 2800.00 less USD 600.00, USD 5200.00. USD 5200.00 is not less than USD 5000.00, so the member meets the tier. Had the return been for USD 800.01, the total would have been USD 4999.99, below the maintenance spend, and the member would keep the tier for the grace months the tier allows and then move down one tier. A total of exactly USD 5000.00 meets the tier.

## 8. Points of judgement

- Spend booked before the date the current tier took effect belongs to an earlier membership year and does not count.
- A bonus entry carries no qualifying spend and does not enter the total.
- A member two tiers' worth below their maintenance spend moves down one tier at the review, not two.
